heading_path: Division 2—Proceedings before the Registrar or a court
text: (1) The regulations may make provision for and in relation to the awarding of costs by the Registrar against a party to proceedings brought before the Registrar. (1A) Without limiting subsection (1), the regulations may make provision for and in relation to the following: (a) the matters in respect of which the Registrar may award costs; (b) the amount of costs that may be awarded by the Registrar (including by providing that the amount of costs is in the discretion of the Registrar). (2) A party desiring to obtain costs must apply to the Registrar in accordance with the regulations. (3) If a party is ordered to pay the costs of another party, the costs may be recovered in a court of competent jurisdiction as a debt due by the first party to the other party.
title: Costs awarded by Registrar
